quote: Rasim, who never quite believed the sea would swallow him, was on the helm like a prayer, hands grafted to the tiller.
Rasim pulled his coat tighter and coughed once as he took the top step, like a man testing whether he could keep standing if the world decided to press on him.

value: bundle of bitter herbs (received from Amina in s-004).
quote: I caught Rasim's hand and dropped the bitter herb bundle into it.

value: has a cough; visibly thinner and showing frailty during the voyage (provenance: s-005)
quote: Rasim leaned at the wheel and coughed into the back of his sleeve the way a man keeps a small worry to himself.
Rasim's cough cut into the moment like a small bell. He held the wheel with both hands until the veins stood in them; the cough took a bit more from him each time and left him paler around the mouth.
